subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept the Codex Action sandbox-bootstrap changes and the coordinated upgrades to Actions that handle app tokens, registry credentials, and release automation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but CI cannot determine whether the changed third-party execution and sandbox behavior matches the repository’s intended security posture.

options.title: Approve after exact-head proof
options.body: Rebase and merge after the relevant workflow checks pass and a maintainer confirms the upstream security and sandbox changes are acceptable.

options.title: Split sensitive upgrades
options.body: Separate Codex Action, token, and registry-related updates from routine setup and scanning Action bumps for narrower security review.

options.title: Hold this update group
options.body: Pause the grouped bump until maintainers can review the upstream security-sensitive release changes individually.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge after the relevant workflow checks pass and a maintainer confirms the upstream security and sandbox changes are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion timeline directly routes this security-sensitive workflow update to steipete, while file-history attribution is otherwise broad across the workflow tree.
